title: rewake mod protocol v1
description: The protocol between the mod inside the harness and its run's wrapper: HTTP/1.1 over the run's mod socket, every endpoint a POST with a JSON body under /v1/, every request checked by its peer (docs/claude.md#the-protocol). An endpoint answers 200 with its answer, or another status with a Refusal. tools/protogen writes the Go and TypeScript types from this file; edit it, never them.

maxBodyBytes.description: is the largest request body the endpoint reads; a longer one is refused before it is parsed.

maxWaitSeconds.description: is the longest the endpoint holds a request before it answers, since the mod's fetch gives up after 30 seconds; a longer wait is a loop of polls.

maxEndBodyBytes.description: is the largest turn/end body the endpoint reads, in place of maxBodyBytes, counted in the UTF-8 bytes of the whole JSON body: a turn's answer can be longer than the other requests, and the mod cuts one that would pass it, saying how much it left out.

aliveHoldSeconds.description: is how long the endpoint holds a mod/alive poll before it answers; the mod sends the next at once.

maxMirrorEventBytes.description: bounds one mirror/events event serialized: a longer delta is split, a longer settle sent in parts.

maxMirrorBatchBytes.description: bounds one mirror/events body, which so always holds at least one event with its envelope, within maxBodyBytes.

maxMirrorOutboxBytes.description: bounds the mirror events the mod holds unsent, mirrorMarkerBytes of it kept for lost markers and turn events; past it the oldest deltas go, then the oldest settles, each leaving a lost marker, then the markers collapse into one resync (docs/face.md).

mirrorMarkerBytes.description: is the part of maxMirrorOutboxBytes kept for lost markers and turn events.

maxMirrorBlockBytes.description: bounds one text or thinking block the mod puts together for its settle, cut to its head and tail past it as the face's item is.

aliveLapseSeconds.description: is how long the endpoint waits for the next mod/alive poll, from the last one's arrival or the hello's, before the load's heartbeat lapses and what the mod proved is withdrawn.

x-endpoints.description: is the first request of every load of the mod.
reports a turn's start of the session's own conversation, from the mod of every role.

reports a turn's end of the session's own conversation, from the mod of every role, retried with the same end id until its receipt comes; 410 says the run is proven gone, so the end has no destination and is not sent again.

is the heartbeat of an admitted load: a poll held for aliveHoldSeconds and sent again as soon as it is answered; a poll of a lapsed or older generation of the current load is refused with 409, on which the newest generation's chain says hello again, and a poll of a superseded load with 410, on which it stops.
asks which of the runs whose unacknowledged ends the harness's store keeps rewake proves ended, so an admitted load may remove their entries; it changes nothing on the host.
acknowledges a control request or reports its final outcome.

carries the conversation of a session rewake's own face draws, from a load whose hello answer said mirror, to the model the wrapper keeps in memory for the face (docs/face.md); 409 refuses a load or generation that is not the run's current one, and the batch is dropped, never sent again.

says the harness has begun to end its process, from main's mod at /exit and at session.end with an exit reason, before the harness's screen goes or as soon after as the harness tells; a main in rewake's shell has its closing screen started by it (docs/shell.md), and nothing else changes on the host.

reports what the status line of a run with a mod is told — the prompt cache's life, effort, the model's name and thinking — which Claude Code starts as a child of the harness and rewake's `rewake statusline` fills; unlike every other endpoint its peer may be any descendant of the harness's process, since its payload is telemetry and nothing it says is acted on. Not an endpoint of the mod.

opens a permission request or a question of a worker's run for main to answer (docs/permission-requests.md): the host leaves main a notify naming it and answers its id; 409 says the run is no worker or the room has no main to ask, and the question stays the person's at the screen.

is a long poll of an open request: answered with main's answer once main gives it, or once the request is settled or past its deadline, or after maxWaitSeconds less five as pending; 404 names a request this run does not hold.
ends an open request with the answer that came first, which main's waiting rewake answer hears; 404 names a request this run does not hold.

AskKind.description: is what a request asks: a permission for a call, or the model's own question.

AskOpenRequest.description: is a request to open: what the harness's question dialog shows, and for a permission the call it is about.

tool.description: is a permission's tool, as the model names it.

input.description: is a permission's call arguments as JSON text, cut by the mod to what a body takes.

cwd.description: is the directory the worker runs in.

readOnly.description: says the engine's check called a permission's call read-only (Claude Code 2.1.304+), absent when it did not say; the call is still main's to answer.

questions.description: are the dialog's questions; a permission's one question has its three choices.

AskQuestion.description: is one question of a dialog.

question.description: is the question's text, which an answer is keyed by.

multiSelect.description: says several options may be chosen.

options.description: are the question's options, in order.

AskOption.description: is one option of a question.

label.description: is the option's label, which an answer names.

id.description: is the request's id, which main's answer names.

AskPollRequest.description: asks what became of an open request.

AskState.description: is what became of a request: nothing yet, main's answer, settled, or past its deadline.

AskPollAnswer.description: is what became of a request.

state.description: is what became of the request.

answers.description: are main's answers, one per question, when answered.

reason.description: is the reason main gave a refused permission.

AskAnswer.description: is main's answer to one question.

answer.description: is the label chosen, the labels chosen joined with a comma and a space, or the text typed under Other.

AskWinner.description: is the answer a request was settled with: main's, the person's at the screen, none by the deadline, or none because the call was cut short.

winner.description: is the answer that came first.

Refusal.description: is the answer of an endpoint that did not do what was asked, with a status other than 200.

error.description: says why, in words for a person.

loadSeq.description: is, on a hello refused 410 for a number below the current load's, that load's number: a load whose store shows no number above its own takes the next above this one and says hello once more.

StatusLineRequest.description: is what the status line's input tells of the session as Claude Code gave it — its prompt_cache, effort, model name and thinking — without transcript content.

ttl.description: is the cache's lifetime of the last request, 5m or 1h, absent when unknown.

expiresAt.description: is when the cache expires, in seconds since the epoch, absent when unknown.

warm.description: says Claude Code takes the cache for warm; absent when the input has no prompt_cache, before the first request, and then no cache field is sent.

effort.description: is the input's effort.level, the session's effort setting, which follows /effort before any request; absent for a model without effort.

modelName.description: is the input's model.display_name, the harness's own name of the session's model, which follows /model; absent when the input has none.

thinking.description: is the input's thinking.enabled, whether the session's thinking is on, which follows its toggle; absent when the input has none.

ClosingRequest.description: says the harness's process has begun to end.

reason.description: is why, in the harness's word for a session's end (prompt_input_exit for /exit, ctrl+c and ctrl+d).

MirrorBatch.description: is the events of a session rewake's face draws, in the order the mod saw them, at most maxMirrorBatchBytes; one batch in flight, never sent again.

loadId.description: is the load sending, the one its admitted hello named.

MirrorEvent.description: is one thing the session showed, in the face's neutral words (docs/face.md): a prompt, a delta of a block then its settle in parts, a tool call's start, input and result, a turn's state, a lost settle or a resync standing for what the outbox dropped.

id.description: names the item: a prompt's, a block's, a tool call's.

block.description: is what a delta or a settle streams.

text.description: is a delta's text, a settle's part, a prompt's text, a tool's input or its result.

status.description: is how a tool call ended, or refused on a prompt of the face the engine dropped.

of.description: is how many parts the settle has.

lost.description: counts the events a resync stands for.

permit.description: is how the call of a result was let run or refused, where the mod could tell.

mode.description: is the session's permission mode as Claude Code names it, on a mode event.

MirrorPermit.description: is who let a call run or refused it, in the face's words (docs/face.md, Permit).

allowed.description: says the call was let run.

reason.description: is a refusal's text as the session's screen writes it after the decider's name, a link included, within a short field.

MirrorPermitBy.description: is who settled a call: a settings rule, the mode or the tool's own check, auto mode's classifier, the person at the dialog, rewake's permission request, a hook.

MirrorBlock.description: is a block's kind: a reply's text or thinking.

MirrorEnd.description: is how a tool call ended.

MirrorTurn.description: is the turn's state a turn event says.

Done.description: is the answer of an endpoint that did what was asked and has nothing to say.

HelloRequest.description: is what a load of the mod says of itself.

loadId.description: names this load of the mod; a reload is a new load, and every later request carries the id its hello gave.

sessionId.description: is the harness's id of the conversation the load runs in.

harnessVersion.description: is the harness's version as the mod reads it.

loadSeq.description: orders the run's loads: each load takes the next number of a counter the harness's store keeps for the run, so a later load's is higher; a hello is bound only with a number above the run's current load's, the same number is that load's retry, and a lower one is refused 410 as superseded.

HelloAnswer.description: is what the run is, for this load.

role.description: is the run's role, as rewake's role catalogue names it.

generation.description: is the load's heartbeat generation, which every mod/alive poll of this hello carries; a retried hello of a live generation gets the same one.

mirror.description: says rewake's own face draws the session: the load sends its conversation to mirror/events, in memory only (docs/face.md); absent otherwise.

AliveRequest.description: is one poll of a load's heartbeat.

loadId.description: is the load polling, the one its admitted hello named.

generation.description: is the heartbeat generation the hello answered.

EndedRequest.description: names the other runs whose ends the harness's store keeps.

epochs.description: are up to 32 epochs of other runs, as the store's index names them.

EndedAnswer.description: says which of the asked runs rewake proves ended: of another boot, or their wrapper gone with its start time.

ended.description: are the epochs proven ended; one alive or that cannot be told is left out.

TurnStartRequest.description: is a turn's start of the session's own conversation; a subagent's turn is not sent.

loadId.description: is the load that saw the start.

conversation.description: is the conversation the turn runs in.

TurnEndRequest.description: is a turn's end of the session's own conversation, sent again with the same end id until its receipt comes.

loadId.description: is the admitted load sending the end, which need not be the load that saw it: a later load of the run sends what an earlier one stored, and the end stays its end id and its content.

conversation.description: is the conversation the turn ran in.

endId.description: names this end once and for good: the same end sent again carries the same id and is taken once.

answer.description: is the turn's final text, or what the harness said of its failure; cut by the mod at the last whole character that keeps the body within maxEndBodyBytes, with a line saying how many characters were left out; absent when the turn gave none.

EndReason.description: is why a turn ended, mapped from the harness's own reason.

Receipt.description: says the core took a turn's start or end.

endId.description: is the end taken; absent for a start.

ControlCommand.description: is one command for the current heartbeat generation.

action.description: is compact, interrupt, or prompt from rewake's own face.

text.description: is a prompt's text, typed as the person; absent for any other action.

AliveAnswer.description: may carry one command; the next heartbeat never waits for its completion.

control.description: is the command dispatched once to this generation.

StateRequest.description: is a complete current observation, without transcript content.

model.description: is the configured model, absent when unknown.

effort.description: is the reasoning effort the latest main-loop request of this load asked for, absent until one is seen.

tokens.description: is current input context usage, absent when unknown.

window.description: is the context window, absent when unknown.

percent.description: is the filled percentage, absent when unknown.

cacheRead.description: is the input tokens the prompt cache served on the latest main-loop response of this load, absent until one reports usage.

cacheWrite.description: is the input tokens that response wrote to the prompt cache.

cacheInput.description: is the input tokens that response neither read from nor wrote to the cache.

compacting.description: says a native compaction is in progress.

compactions.description: counts completed compactions observed by this load.

request.description: names the latest completed compaction request, empty for native compaction.

from.description: names its requester, empty for native compaction.

dialog.description: is what the harness said of a dialog the session waits at on its screen that the mod carries to nobody, absent when none; the host tells main once per dialog.

waiting.description: is what a dialog the session waits at on its screen asks while the mod holds it — a permission, or the model's own question — absent when none.

ControlReply.description: is an initial or final result for a dispatched command.

outcome.description: is requested, done, refused or failed.

reason.description: is the fixed control reason, when known.

detail.description: explains the outcome without transcript content.

open.description: says the native outcome is not yet known.

tokensBefore.description: is context usage before compaction, when supplied.

tokensAfter.description: is context usage after compaction, when supplied.
